name: Account Permission Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the permission to use the account.

NORI.name: No Right
NORI.definition: No right to use the account.

RIAL.name: Right To Use Alone
RIAL.definition: Right to use the account alone.

RIWI.name: Right To Use With Other
RIWI.definition: Right to use the account together with another person.
